request: Implement src/export_events.py run(payload). Convert timestamp (offset-aware ISO string) to UTC ISO with Z suffix. Preserve seconds/microseconds represented by datetime.isoformat; reject naive timestamps with ValueError. Preserve all public interfaces stated here. Python entrypoint is src.export_events.run(payload). Inputs are JSON objects; return only plain JSON-compatible values (no Decimal objects, sets or tuples). Use only the standard library. Visible test tools check syntax only; functional verification is external.
title: Convert timestamps to ISO 8601 UTC
